name: oak-office
description: A virtual office where you talk to a department lead while hired agents work at their desks.

scripts.dev: CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply oak-office --local && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply oak-office --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply oak-office --remote --env production
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
